title: Personal Blog Platform
description: A full-featured blog platform built with Node.js, Express, and EJS. Features include post categorization, pagination, photo galleries, and a responsive Bootstrap UI.

title: Task Manager API
description: A RESTful API for managing tasks and projects. Built with Node.js and PostgreSQL, featuring JWT authentication, role-based access control, and full CRUD operations.

title: Weather Dashboard
description: A real-time weather dashboard that aggregates data from multiple APIs. Displays current conditions, 7-day forecasts, and historical trends with interactive charts.

title: E-Commerce Store
description: A full-stack e-commerce application with product listings, shopping cart, Stripe payment integration, and an admin dashboard for inventory management.

title: CLI Dev Toolkit
description: A collection of command-line utilities for automating common development tasks: project scaffolding, git hooks, code formatting, and deployment scripts.

title: Data Visualization Library
description: A lightweight charting library built on top of SVG. Supports bar charts, line charts, pie charts, and scatter plots with smooth animations and responsive design.
